name: update_customer_profile
description: Update contact details on a customer account. At least one of email, phone or address must be supplied; fields that are omitted are left unchanged. Supplying an address whose address_id already exists replaces that address in place; omitting address_id adds a new one. This tool does not change the address on an order that has already been placed.

address.description: A postal address. line1, city, state and postal_code are all required.

address_id.description: Existing address to replace. Omit to add a new address.

line2.description: Apartment, suite or unit. May be empty.

error_returns.when: No account exists with the given customer_id.
No updatable field was supplied, email lacks an '@', or address is missing a required field.
